title: OpenBot: Unleash Trusted AI Coworkers Right on Your Machine!
contentMarkdown:
## 📝 Quick Summary: 
OpenBot is an open-source platform for running AI agents, referred to as 'coworkers,' within your own infrastructure. It provides each agent with a dedicated browser, file access, and tools, all governed by a secure gateway that logs every action. This allows for trusted delegation of real work to AI agents.

## 🔑 Key Takeaways

- ✅ OpenBot provides isolated, trustworthy AI coworkers with controlled access to tools.

- ✅ Every AI action is transparently previewed and recorded for full oversight.

- ✅ It's a self-hosted, customizable agent platform, not a SaaS product.

- ✅ Supports various AI agent frameworks via the open AG-UI protocol, ensuring flexibility.

- ✅ Offers enhanced security, privacy, and customization for integrating AI into workflows.


## 📊 Project Statistics
- ⭐ Stars: 4337
- 🍴 Forks: 535

## 🛠 Tech Stack
- ✅ TypeScript


Ever wished you could hand off tasks to an AI agent, but hesitated due to concerns about security, control, or just plain trust? We've all been there. Giving an AI access to your tools and data feels like a huge leap of faith. But what if there was a way to get the best of both worlds: powerful AI assistance with complete transparency and iron-clad control? Enter OpenBot, a game-changing GitHub project that's about to redefine how we integrate AI into our workflows.OpenBot isn't just another AI tool; it's an entire agent platform designed to give you 'AI coworkers' that you can genuinely trust. Imagine each AI bot getting its very own virtual computer – a real browser with its own logins, its own files, and only the specific tools *you* explicitly grant access to. This isolation is a game-changer for security. What's more, every single action the bot decides to take is previewed *before* it happens and meticulously recorded *after*, giving you an unprecedented level of oversight. You can literally watch it work on its own screen, and even 'take the wheel' if it's about to do something you'd rather handle manually, then hand control back.Crucially, OpenBot runs entirely on your own infrastructure, typically via Docker Compose on your machine. This means your data stays with you, and you choose the AI model. It's designed as a 'template, not a product' – you clone it, customize it with your own agents and skills, and make it yours. This flexibility extends to the agents themselves: OpenBot is built on AG-UI, an open protocol, meaning you can bring agents built with popular frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, or even custom-written ones, and they'll all integrate seamlessly.The benefits for developers are huge. First, **unparalleled security and control**. You dictate what tools your AI coworkers can use and monitor their every move, eliminating the 'black box' problem. Second, **extreme flexibility**. Because it's a template and uses an open protocol, you're not locked into a specific AI framework or vendor. You can integrate your existing agent projects or build new ones with ease. Third, **privacy and ownership**. Running on your own machine means your sensitive data never leaves your environment. This is a massive advantage for compliance and proprietary information. Finally, **customization potential**. OpenBot provides a robust foundation, allowing you to tailor AI coworkers to solve your specific, unique problems, whether it's automating repetitive dev tasks, managing internal knowledge, or even assisting with risk analysis. It empowers you to create intelligent automation with confidence.
